---
title: "AI Use Policy"
---

## Default rule

AI use is generally permitted and often required in DSA261 because learning how to use AI well is part of the course.

Permission to use AI does **not** transfer responsibility to AI.

## What you must be able to show

For assessed TRACE work, you may be asked to document:

- the prompt or query you used;
- how the prompt/query changed;
- what the AI contributed;
- what you rejected or corrected;
- what external evidence you used;
- what decision remained yours.

## Verification rule

> **An LLM answer, citation, summary, or confidence statement is not independent verification evidence.**

Verification must leave the model and reach an appropriate external source, dataset, document, or other independently inspectable evidence.

## Disclosure

When a Task asks for AI-use disclosure, report the actual use. Productive, transparent AI use is not penalised. Unverifiable or falsely represented process evidence may be.
